title: Google Quantum AI: Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation
headline: We are building the cheapest quantum circuits we can for three tasks, and our best graded entry so far scored 24.77234 on 5 November. We are now checking public ideas for further savings and have not sent a newer entry since.

board.note: Score is Kaggle's graded result for our 5 November entry. No board place has been read since 24 October, when we were 56th of 723 teams at a score of 8.87, so the current place is not known.

entries.note: Counts read from Kaggle just before our 5 November entry (2 used that day, 41 in all, 3 still allowed) plus that one entry. Nothing newer is recorded.
